name: Alaska Airlines Arena at Hec Edmundson Pavilion

bagPolicy.summary: Approved bags are clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches, one-gallon clear resealable bags, or clutches up to 4.5 x 6.5 inches. Clear diaper bags that meet the size rule are permitted.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: University of Washington Transportation Services manages event parking; guests should use the official arena parking and traffic map for the event.
